svg.aria-label: The path: lanes against time, with a now line at September 20, 2026. A ship-fence band under the axis says the fence STANDS, not lifted: the W4 first-cut issues are Done but FIX-1407 is In Review, so no W5 ship ticket may open, while polish may start now. Two input lanes from other epics: the W3 floor FIX-1351 carries a bar reaching the now line, landed, with seats, channels and skills on disk and DevForce's first build slice; and the W4 first cut FIX-1407 carries a bar reaching the now line, first cut landed, epic still In Review. Then the rows of the set. FIX-1467, references versus resources, carries a completed bar that ends before the now line, marked Done and merged September 20, and labelled ER-18 met, not a proving leg. FIX-1468, ReadOnlyResourceRef, is a dashed not-started lane beginning after the now line, marked Backlog, not a proving leg. FIX-1469, the goals labs migration, is a dashed not-started lane beginning after the now line, marked Backlog, not a proving leg, with its kitchen-sink half stale. Then the three exit-proof lanes, each carrying no bar at all, only labels: the Devtool checklist, marked NO CHILD, not filed, with rows four and six failing today; the DevForce proof path, marked NO CHILD, not filed, with its first build slice done in W3; and the multi-seat collab scenario, marked NO CHILD, not filed. Last, a short terminated lane for FIX-1458, humans in seats, whose stub stops at September 20 with an X, canceled, pull request 1955 closed unmerged, kept and not deleted. The route to the done condition is drawn in the gutter as three hollow dots joined by a broken line across the three proof lanes only: it has no owners at any point along it. A note says the set is open and that every exit proof is a lane waiting to be filed, which is normal course under rule ER-23. Under a divider, related lanes that are not in the set: kitchen-sink FIX-1455, a sibling epic that left the set on September 20; FIX-1320 flow instances, Spec Approved, which already owns the Devtool instance and session surfaces that three checklist rows read on, flagged as a possible collision; FIX-1442 org never optional, wrap-gating because no proof is observable without org identity; and FIX-1341 Collab park, later and never the whole of W5.
svg.text: THE PATH — ONE LANE PER ROW OF THE SET, AGAINST TIME
